stem: A box has a square base with sides of \((x + 2)\) centimeters and a height of 5 centimeters. The volume of the box, in cubic centimeters, can be written as \(ax^{2} + bx + c\), where \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\) are constants. What is the value of \(b\)?
solution: The volume is base area times height: \(5(x + 2)^{2}\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
p = Poly(expand(5*(x + 2)**2), x)
assert p.coeff_monomial(x) == 20
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [20]
